> Ashley — attaching a temporary export of the inventory Jonass will confirm shortly.

Hi all — attaching the definitive subprocessor inventory (CSV) and a short technical note below.

Subprocessors relevant to telemetry/cookies/notifications (summary):
- AWS (eu-west-1, eu-central-1) — hosting and primary telemetry ingestion (EU data residency available).
- Fastly / CDN partners (eu POPs) — edge caching only, no analytics processing.
- Segment (EU data residency enabled customer-by-customer) — customer-configurable; by default EU customers can opt-in to EU-only Segment workspace.
- SendGrid (US) — transactional emails (we can configure to route via EU mail relay for enterprise customers).
- Sentry (for error telemetry) — EU org available; we can pin projects to EU.

Telemetry / cookie behaviour:
- Redwood web SDK sets a first-party session cookie to maintain socket/session state (no cross-site or ad-network cookies).
- We do not inject third-party marketing cookies from the SDK by default. Any marketing pixels or GTM containers added by customers will behave per the customer's GTM config.
- Telemetry exports: by default events are processed in the region of the customer's org; for customers in EU we process and store telemetry in EU regions unless the customer enables global exports.

Retention windows (default, can be customized per account):
- Session/state cookies: 7 days (rolling).
- Raw telemetry events / logs: 30 days.
- Aggregated analytics / dashboards: 13 months.

Compliance controls we offer: SCCs for transfers, EU-only KMS key option, contractual DPA (attached), audit logs on data access, subprocessor notifications 30 days prior to changes.

Marissa — can you confirm whether Acme’s GTM install will be via our Console-managed snippet or customer-managed? That will change whether we need to coordinate tag whitelisting.

-Jonas
Privacy & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Ashley — attaching the signed standard DPA and the finalized subprocessor inventory per your request. Answers to your checklist below (copied for your privacy reviewer):

1) Subprocessor inventory: attached (subprocessor_inventory_20270628.csv). Key notes: AWS eu clusters used for EU orgs; SendGrid present for email but we can route via EU relay for enterprise; Segment is customer-configurable EU-only workspace.

2) DPA: attached (DPA_signed_v1.pdf). The DPA includes SCCs for transfers and our standard EU-only KMS option is called out in section 4.

3) Telemetry / cookie behaviour: Redwood SDK does NOT set third-party ad cookies or share identifiers with ad networks by default. 4) Data residency & retention: EU customers can be configured to keep telemetry ingestion and storage in EU regions. Defaults: session 7d, raw events 30d, aggregated analytics 13 months — these are adjustable in the Console or via a support request.
